blocked.name: Dragonhawk, Fate's Tempest
blocked.why: At your next end step, 2 damage to each opponent for each card exiled this way that's still exiled; nothing tracks which of them remain.

blocked.name: Jaya's Immolating Inferno
blocked.why: The legendary sorcery casting restriction (rule 205.4e).

blocked.name: Manabarbs
blocked.why: 'Whenever a player taps a land for mana' dealing damage: a tapped-for-mana trigger is only ever a triggered mana ability, never put on the stack.

blocked.name: Squee, the Immortal
blocked.why: 'You may cast this card from your graveyard or from exile': a card's own permission to be cast from those zones. Gravecrawler (K2) waits on it too.

blocked.name: Wrathful Red Dragon
blocked.why: 'Any target that isn't a Dragon': no target spec narrows 'any target' by a filter.

blocked.name: Starfield of Nyx
blocked.why: Each other non-Aura enchantment is a creature with base P/T equal to its own mana value, as a static; only a one-shot (Zur) exists.

blocked.name: Quilled Greatwurm
blocked.why: Cast from your graveyard by removing six counters from among creatures you control.

blocked.name: Dracogenesis
blocked.why: An alternative cost for Dragon spells; with Jodah, Archmage Eternal out too, the engine offers only the first alternative cost it finds rather than the player's choice.

blocked.name: Rooftop Storm
blocked.why: An alternative cost for Zombie creature spells; beside Jodah the engine offers only the first alternative cost it finds.

blocked.name: Fighter Class
blocked.why: Class levels.

blocked.name: Glittering Stockpile
blocked.why: '{T}: Add {R}. Put a stash counter on this artifact' is a mana ability (rule 605.1a), but here a mana ability can only add mana; with the counter it would use the stack.

blocked.name: Thrumming Stone
blocked.why: Ripple, granted to the spells you cast.

blocked.name: Dance of the Dead
blocked.why: Enchant creature card in a graveyard (Animate Dead's shape).

blocked.name: Riot Control
blocked.why: 'Prevent all damage that would be dealt to you this turn'; prevent-damage is a shield of a fixed size.

blocked.name: Plargg and Nassari
blocked.why: Each player exiles until a nonland card, an opponent picks one, and you may cast up to two of the others free.

blocked.name: Umbral Mantle
blocked.why: A granted '{3}, {Q}' ability; there's no untap-symbol cost.

blocked.name: The Cabbage Merchant
blocked.why: 'Whenever a creature deals combat damage to you': the per-creature combat damage trigger can't narrow the player dealt damage to you.

blocked.name: Nexus of Fate
blocked.why: 'If it would be put into a graveyard from anywhere, reveal it and shuffle it into its owner's library instead'; only 'exile instead' exists. Darksteel Colossus waits on it too.

blocked.name: Grafted Exoskeleton
blocked.why: Infect, and 'whenever this Equipment becomes unattached from a permanent, sacrifice that permanent'.

blocked.name: Summon: Primal Odin
blocked.why: Chapter II grants 'that player loses the game'; no effect makes a player lose.

blocked.name: Lignify
blocked.why: Kindred Enchantment — Treefolk Aura.

blocked.name: Kindred Summons
blocked.why: Choose a creature type, then reveal until X creature cards of it.

blocked.name: Arcane Bombardment
blocked.why: Copy each card exiled with it and cast any number of the copies free.

blocked.name: Grave Researcher // Reanimate
blocked.why: Prepared.

blocked.name: Oblivion Sower
blocked.why: Put any number of land cards that player owns from among the exiled cards onto the battlefield under your control.

blocked.name: Inscription of Abundance
blocked.why: Life equal to the greatest power among creatures the target player controls; kicked, any number of modes.

blocked.name: Summon: Yojimbo
blocked.why: 'Creatures can't attack you unless their controller pays {2} for each' until your next turn.

blocked.name: Constant Mists
blocked.why: Buyback — sacrifice a land.

blocked.name: Tainted Strike
blocked.why: Gains infect until end of turn.

blocked.name: Hazel's Brewmaster
blocked.why: Foods have all activated abilities of all creature cards exiled with it.

blocked.name: Slaughter the Strong
blocked.why: Each player keeps creatures with total power 4 or less and sacrifices the rest.

blocked.name: Thieving Skydiver
blocked.why: Kicker {X} (X can't be 0), and a gain-control target bound by X.

blocked.name: Chthonian Nightmare
blocked.why: Pay X {E} and return this enchantment to its owner's hand as costs.

blocked.name: Neoform
blocked.why: The creature found enters with an additional +1/+1 counter; a search can't add counters.
